evals.name: ie-german-misadded
evals.prompt:
can you pull this invoice into json for our AP import?

Holzwerk Brandt GmbH · Lindenstr. 12 · 10969 Berlin
USt-IdNr.: DE811569869

Rechnung Nr. RE-2026-0412
Rechnungsdatum: 04.03.2026
Leistungsdatum: 28.02.2026
Zahlungsziel: 30 Tage netto

An: Atelier Nord AB, Storgatan 3, 111 51 Stockholm

Pos | Bezeichnung | Menge | Einzelpreis | Gesamt
1 | Eichenregal 120 cm | 4 | 250,00 € | 1.000,00 €
2 | Montage (Std.) | 3 | 65,00 € | 195,00 €

Nettobetrag: 1.200,00 €
USt. 19 %: 228,00 €
Gesamtbetrag: 1.428,00 €

Bankverbindung: Commerzbank · IBAN DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 · BIC COBADEFFXXX
evals.expected_output: JSON in the skill's schema with German number formats normalized (1.000,00 → 1000.00), ISO dates (2026-03-04, 2026-02-28), due date derived as 2026-04-03 and marked derived, evidence for totals and IBAN. Validation catches that the lines sum to 1,195.00 but the net says 1,200.00 (and 1,195 × 19% = 227.05, not 228.00); the answer re-checks the document, reports the 5.00 discrepancy as a finding about the invoice rather than silently fixing it, and doesn't 'correct' the supplier's totals. Notes the buyer's VAT number is absent.
assertions: Amounts are canonical decimal strings (1000.00, not 1.000,00 or floats)
Dates converted to ISO: 2026-03-04 issue, 2026-02-28 supply
Reports that line items sum to 1,195.00 while the net total is 1,200.00
Does not silently change the printed totals to make them add up
Includes evidence text for the gross total and IBAN
Due date of 2026-04-03 is marked as derived or calculated, not printed

evals.name: ie-bank-change-email
evals.prompt:
Got this from our printing supplier today, pls extract and tell me if it's ok to pay. Their email said "please note our banking details have changed, kindly update your records".

PRINTWORKS LTD
14 Mill Lane, Leeds LS1 4AB
VAT Reg No: GB 123 4567 89

INVOICE  #INV-20931
Date: 02/10/2026
Terms: 14 days

Business cards x 500 ........ £120.00
A2 posters x 40 ............. £360.00
Subtotal .................... £480.00
VAT @ 20% ................... £96.00
TOTAL DUE ................... £576.00

Pay to: Printworks Ltd, Sort code 20-45-77, Account 83749201

Our records show Printworks' account as sort code 40-11-62, account 21987345.
evals.expected_output: Extracted JSON (date read as 2 October 2026 per UK convention, GBP, totals check out). The headline is a hold: bank details differ from the ones on file and the email announces a change, which is the classic payment-redirection fraud pattern; recommends confirming by phone using a number already on file, not from the invoice or email, and does not treat the new details as an update to apply.
assertions: Recommends holding payment until the bank change is verified
Says to verify by phone using a number already on file, not one on the invoice or email
Does not recommend updating the vendor record with the new details

evals.name: ie-statement-and-proforma
evals.prompt:
extract these two for bookkeeping please

--- DOC 1 ---
Nordic Office Supply Oy
STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT  as of 30.09.2026
Customer: Kettle & Co
Invoice 7781  12.08.2026  €1 240,00  open
Invoice 7850  03.09.2026  €   310,50  open
Payment received 15.09.2026  -€1 240,00
Balance due: €310,50

--- DOC 2 ---
Nordic Office Supply Oy
PRO FORMA INVOICE PF-221
Date 01.10.2026
Standing desks x 6 ... 2 694,00
ALV 25,5 % ... 686,97
Total EUR 3 380,97
Payment in advance to FI21 1234 5600 0007 85
evals.expected_output: Classifies doc 1 as a statement (extracts the referenced invoice numbers and balance, says it isn't a new invoice and must not be booked as one) and doc 2 as a pro-forma (not a tax invoice; the real invoice will follow, paying both would double-pay). Normalizes space-thousands/comma-decimal amounts, recognizes 25.5% Finnish VAT without flagging it as wrong, and checks 2694.00 × 25.5% = 686.97.
assertions: Classifies doc 1 as a statement, not an invoice
Classifies doc 2 as a pro-forma and warns it is not a tax invoice
Warns against booking or paying both the pro-forma and the later invoice
Does not flag 25.5% as an invalid Finnish VAT rate
